book.name: Mak
book.title: Mak Yesus nugau Ze Naliupet Mak nug sikut manaren

content: Yesus nug du tub karweun wes eg mui kasai meun.
Yesus gonugau tapaimaraneun dudu abai tebil oimai, ze unig tubaiman gasageim, Gerasa duailel agal em ebu betemen.
Yesus go tebil uteimai, em ebu silikai nuna, du tub wes eg mui go eb ob darem eiman dareun, alaimai, Yesus peun.
Go eb hiaranemen agal aizau oug ninaneu. Du tub nug go gusig patabun pet iboi tam. Go us gusig sil arab ebeg kiai macanem, bo, go nug us gusig go kuataneun.
Dudu agen go umkoskos ebeg arab sen gusig sil kiai macanemen. Bo, gonug sen go unum kitkuat aneun. Du gue gusig pet, gonun, du tub nug go zilacurabun iborain tam.
Go umkoskos umaum, amban, eb macanem aizau mui em manam wag mui daimai, gusig ulaimai, nugtal go aiwag sil nug nugau enib kitkuataneun.

Gonug Yesus pulig eim uligaimai, pigai alaimai, Yesus nugau arab waugab taubibi aimai, go en gusig uleun, “Yesus, na Uwait wag dareu nugau nag. Na iz erunilamam? Iz Uwait nugau wanib gusig pataimai, aizem, na iz uhu i milen.”
Du go nug enai aureun, einen, Yesus nug amegai aureun, “Wes eg, na du go utei, alien!”
Yesus nug go enai aureun, “Na wanim in?” Gonug koli aureun, “Izal wanim Asiu. Einen, ig wes eg asiu du gonugau ougab oug darem.”
Guzenendai, wes eg agen ig em tub ebu i palautigen aimai Yesus gusig ze auremen.
Bo agen asiu em manam tub tubaiman ee zai daremen.
Gonun, wes eg go agen Yesus gusig ze aurinar, “Ig palautigemen, bo go daremen agal oiagab oug simam.”

Guzenai aurina, Yesus nug awareun, “Iboi, ag alian!” Guzenai awarina, wes eg asiu du gue uteimai, bo goagal oiagab oug sinar. Bo gue asiu tausen aliag (2,000) sag. Go uminaimai, pigai em eg eiman beteimai, ze unig oug noimai, ze zaimai, nouminar.
Bo gumaranemen dudu go igul go uligaimai, pigai uminai beteimai, goagal uzan mui, ipal go uzan waugaban duailel unum awarinar. Awarina, doimai, duailel unum ein igul usaleun piabun aimai betemenin.
Goagen Yesus waugab alaimai, du go getal wes eg mui dareun ulis go tibur galau tugaimai, dabeleu naliu mui hoboi darendai, pemen. Duailel ag go uligaimai, umininar.
Duailel go Yesus nug go igul guzeneun uligaimai, agen betei, duailel ipal bo gue erunemen ze mui, du getal wes eg asiu gonugau ougab oug dareun go naliu usaleun ze mui unum awareun.
Duailel ze go doimai, Yesus goagal uzan uteimai, uzan tub unabun aimai gusig ze aurinar.
Guzenina, Yesus nug gonugau tebil wag siabun aimai, du go getal wes eg mui dareun naliu usaleun gonug Yesus gusig aureun, “Iz na ibaiz unai, na iz io ailamam ta?”
Guzenai aurina, Yesus nug koli go io aurab tam. Gonug du go enai aureun, “Na nait uzan beteiba, Uwait nug na en bisom peimai, igul e ebitab meun nait ug unum awaramam.”
Guzenai aurendai, du gonug beteimai, ban uzan houhou sag, wanib Dekapolis, go ebuan duailel Yesus nug go erunena, usaleun ze awareun. Duailel unum go ze go doimai, esilakaimai, dabeleu asiu unar.
Yesus nug ainag noumeun mui, ebeu air mui, kasareun.
Yesus go tebil ebu simai, Galili Ze Unig tubaim gasag koli beteun. Go ze gasageim us nogoug ebu nuna, duailel asiu alaimai gotulinar.

Zuda agal gotulanemen zau gumaneun du tub, gonugau wanib Zairus, go alaimai, Yesus peimai, waugab zoimai taubibi aimai, gusig ze aureun, “Izal alegwai noumamoroi. Na alaiba, nait eben go ebu memen, go koli naliu usalamau.”
Yesus ze uteimai, go du dual ereg beteun. Guzenina, duailel asiu go ereg Yesus sesamorai betemen.
Duailel ula ebu, air tub dareun. Go geil ebeu umkoskos waneu, ebeu go gonugau wai begurug (12) sag dareun.
Ebeu kasaranemen dudu asiu agen go kasai maimai, mu asiu muranemen. Gonugau aiwag go ebeu kasaranemen dudu ebalagab poaneun. Bo, gonugau ebeu maziab tam, go ebeu banou oi dareun.
Go dudu ipal agen Yesus en ze mina, doimai, go ula daimai, go Yesus seugab zoimai, Yesus nugau tibur galau patar.
Go enai dabeleun, “Iz gonugau tibur galau sag pataimai, iz koli naliu manai.”
Guzenaimai, go tibur galau patena, gonugau ebeu mazianar. Go doun, gonugau enib ebu ebeu tam eun. Go naliu usaleun.
Yesus nug gonugau gusig wanena, abe maimai, kekulaimai, awareun, “Inugau ebeg nug izal tibur galau pateu?”
Gonugau tapaimaraneu dudu agen auremen, “Duailel asiu gotulaimai gagizem, na einen ‘Inugau ebeg nug iz patileu’ aimai awaremen?”
Bo, Yesus nug inug guzenileun aimai ameg nugtal itaneun.
Air go ein igul go ebu usaleun abiu maimai, go banban uminaimai, Yesus waugab taubibi aimai, gonugau ze unum petak aureun.
Guzenina, Yesus nug aureun, “Ainag, nait ounab petak eun, gonun, nait enim naliu usaleun. Na ounab selai mui alien. Nait ebeu unum maziamau.”
Yesus nug zemai daren, dudu ipal Zuda agal gotulanemen zau gumaneun du Zairus nugau zauan alaimai, Zairus auremen, “Zairus, nait alen noumeun. Na einen tapaimaraneun du salau muramam?”
Yesus nug ze go doimai, Zairus aureun, “Na umin ien, nait ounab petak en!”
Go guzenai auraimai, duailel asiu imarab tam. Pita, Zems zaug Zon (Zems nugau amag) go sag Yesus sesamorai betemen.

Go Zairus nugau zaueim alina, duailel asiu agen manil maimai, saipag hei daremen. Yesus nug uligaraimai, awareun, “Ag einen saipag hei daremen? Ag einen manil mai daremen? Ainag go noumab tam, go gaul gabuai dareu.”

Yesus guzenina, go peimai, weloronar. Gonug duailel uzaneim nuabun palautaren, nondai, ainag nugau memeg anag abai ereg gonugau tapaimaraneu dudu ainarai mui, ag sag ainag nugau zau empip oug imarai siar.
Simai, gonug ainag nugau ebeg pataimai, Zuda ze eiman guzenai aureun: “Talita kum”, ze go bigeg enai, ‘Ainag, izan aizem, na asen.’
Guzenina, ainag go pigai asaimai, kolital aidareun. Ainag go gonugau wai 12 sag. Duailel daremen go igul go uligaimai, banban esilakinar.
Yesus nug ze gusig awareun, “Ag igul go pemen duailel ipal i awaran. Ulis ag ainag go ee ipal moron.”
